short: Lip2Wav's per-speaker natural corpus (M03) is ahead; its attention decoder (M06) is standard, since LipSound had one in 2019; Table 2 mixes copied and re-run baseline rows.
position: Lip2Wav [@prajwal2020lip2wav] changes the training corpus (M03) and the decoder (M06). The corpus is ahead: none of the 10 prior video-to-speech synthesizers trained on unconstrained speech or on more than about 1 h per speaker, and the five separately trained speakers became the single-speaker benchmark. The decoder is standard: LipSound [@qu2019lipsound] already mapped whole 3-s lip clips to mel spectrograms with an attention decoder, teacher forcing and Griffin-Lim, and is cited only as lip-to-text work. The evaluation (M12) is standard; two GRID WERs in Table 2 equal values measured with another recognizer, and all ablations are one speaker, one run.
